aiVerification.summary: Draft misidentifies the primary comparison; source supports C2 vs E2 under shared lot/plasma context, not Normal vs Test.
issues: Primary changed factor is wrong: evidence title/purpose centers C2 vs E2.
Normal/Test rows are secondary content within tension, not the workbook-level comparison.
Line grouping is lost for tension measurements and defect outcomes.
Function result C2 vs E2 is left unjudged despite comparable NG rates.
LED UV/bonding rows appear header-derived and are not validated as comparable outcomes.
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor as C2 vs E2 with lot CD and plasma C2 as context/subgroup as supported.
Preserve line/date/content grouping for each outcome.
Pair C2 and E2 rows separately for separate check, tension check, tension assay, and function.
Judge comparable NG-rate outcomes and tension averages within the C2/E2 comparison.
Remove or quarantine header-only LED UV/bonding measurement candidates unless data rows are cited.
